subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should Gateway protocol v4 accept a new optional top-level `res.meta` field as the compatibility posture for response metadata, or should this wait for a version-gated or payload-level contract?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but AGENTS.md treats gateway protocol changes as compatibility-sensitive and strict clients generated from the previous `additionalProperties: false` response schema may reject the new top-level field.

options.title: Accept additive `res.meta` in v4
options.body: Resolve the merge conflict and land the optional/defaulted field as the canonical response metadata path for upgraded clients.

options.title: Pause for a versioned contract
options.body: Hold this PR and design a protocol-version bump or alternate metadata location before emitting new top-level response fields.

recommendation.title: Accept additive `res.meta` in v4
recommendation.body: Resolve the merge conflict and land the optional/defaulted field as the canonical response metadata path for upgraded clients.
